description: Turn a rambly spoken or stream-of-consciousness transcript into a clean, faithful first-person knowledge-base note under kb/riffs/. Use when the user pastes a dictated voice dump, says “riff” or “add a riff,” or asks to clean up a journal-style transcription. Preserve every useful idea, aside, hedge, attribution, and coined term; execute embedded transcriber research requests; use attachments as context without embedding the raw files.
